svg.title: Evidence for comparing SBR results
svg.desc: A procedural blank identifies background. A matrix spike measures recovery. A separate check standard verifies the calibration response. Independent sampling supports a treatment comparison.

g.text: Process a blank alongside the samples.
Add a known amount to a representative sample.
Measure a standard held out of the fit.
What background comes from the method?
How much of the addition is recovered?
Does the response meet the criterion?
A treatment comparison also needs independent sampling that represents process variability.
